Below we will track all the touchdowns from tonight’s game and determine a winner.

George Pickens’ 21-yard touchdown in the second quarter was the longest touchdown of the night, making him King of the End Zone. All Pickens bettors will win $65 in bonus bets for their King of the End Zone bets.
